description: Opens one of the connected account's finished videos in Cirrela's "Ready to post" panel: word-by-word captions, music, a voice-over, a new format (9:16, 1:1, 16:9) or a sharper version. Returns the link; the panel shows the exact cost in credits before the click, and the original stays. Needs the person's Cirrela account.

id.description: The video's id, from create_video or get_generation.

kind.description: Optional: which touch-up the person wants.

name: touch_up
title: Get a video ready to post
